entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Finally! I want to return this useless VeloBand tracker. I've had it with this company and I want a refund immediately.
I can certainly look into a return for you. I'm sorry you're not happy with the product. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't you dare call this a preference! The issue is that I couldn't even open the box because of a major family emergency! My husband got a last-minute military deployment, and the stress of it all sent me to the hospital. I had to have emergency surgery and I've been recovering ever since!

I'm so sorry to hear that. That sounds like an incredibly difficult time, and I certainly hope your recovery is going well. Let me pull up your account details to see what we can do. Can I get your email address?
It's sarah.g@email.com. And you better be able to do something, because if not, I'm telling everyone I know how VeloFit treats its customers. I'll be your worst nightmare on social media.
Thank you, I'm pulling up the order now. Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 15th, which was 25 days ago. Let me just take one moment to review the return policy for you.
Yeah, you do that. I'm waiting.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Wait, what? Ninety days? I was expecting a huge fight. I thought I read it was only 10 days or something.

Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're only at day 25, I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I'm happy to help, especially given everything you've been through.
Oh. Well, a full refund is exactly what I wanted. That's... surprisingly easy. Thank you.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email. Just place the tracker back in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you all the best with your recovery.
